title: Legacy report normalization
responsibility: Normalizes an earlier report manifest without upgrading its original status or inventing missing revision and media identities.

inputs.name: legacyReport.manifest
inputs.description: Unknown legacy manifest containing report identity, project, title, mode, environment, state, status and timestamps, with optional summary, checks and evidence.

outputs.name: legacyReport
outputs.description: Project identity and normalized version 1 legacy record, or undefined when validation fails. Original status/times remain; revision is trimmed or null, checks omit extra details, and media starts with null hash/size plus legacy provenance.
